about: A recorded compare for scripts/test_workbench_book.py (slice 4, the bench in the book). Frame shapes are the harness runtime's (system-apps/_harness_runtime/events.py, {ts, seq, kind, payload}): Claude Code's are taken from a real build's feed (status/thinking with 'thinking block (text not returned by the model)' and 'extended thinking — N heartbeats', Bash tool_call with command + description, a tool_result with tool '' and 'Exit code 1' on failure, file_edit {path, tool: Write} followed by its result, prose as text, the terminal status with ok/exit_code/elapsed_seconds/model); Codex's are events.py's codex mapping (thread.started, a kernel waiting frame while queued for memory, shell tool_call/tool_result with id and exit_code, apply_patch and file_edit with change, a turn.completed usage frame). Times are seconds after the brief was sent; the test stamps ts on its own server clock. The content is made up.
